title: Course Map — Tokyo Marathon
claims: The course page gives the marathon distance as 42.195 km.
The course starts at the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building No.1 and finishes at the Wadakura-Gate intersection by Tokyo Station/Gyoko-dori Avenue.
The route passes Suidobashi, Ueno-hirokoji, Kanda, Nihombashi, Asakusa Kaminarimon Gate, Ryogoku, Monzen-nakacho, Ginza, Tamachi and Hibiya.
The page links the 2026 English course map PDF (illustmap_2026en.pdf), which marks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 km plus the 21.0975 km halfway point and the 42.195 km finish.
The 2026 course map shows three turnarounds at Ueno-hirokoji, Tomioka Hachimangu and Tamachi.
The official elevation profile is published as a graphic only; its vertical axis runs to about 40 m, with the start near 40 m and the course dropping to near 0 m before 5 km.
The page currently presents the 2027 edition while linking the 2026 course map; this source is used only for the 2026 map and course description.
